title: Brute Force Authentication Attack
description: High-frequency credential stuffing attack targeting primary authentication server node.

recommendedActions.text: Block Source IP (192.168.1.24) at ingress WAF
Enable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for target accounts

aiAnalysis.explanation: Automated botnet attempting dictionary password matching.
aiAnalysis.recommendedResponse: Enforce strict IP blacklisting and rate limits.

title: Cloud Metadata SSRF Probe
description: Attempted Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) targeting internal AWS IMDSv1 cloud metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254) to harvest IAM role credentials.
businessImpacts: Potential lateral movement across AWS account resources

recommendedActions.text: Block access to 169.254.169.254 via iptables / eBPF rules
Upgrade Cloud Metadata service to IMDSv2 (Token Required)

timeline.title: SSRF payload detected
timeline.desc: Request URL redirected to internal IP

timeline.title: Access Blocked
timeline.desc: IMDS access attempt dropped by firewall

aiAnalysis.explanation: Request forged to query internal metadata service for temporary AWS keys.
aiAnalysis.businessImpact: Potential cloud account escalation if IAM role keys are leaked.
aiAnalysis.recommendedResponse: Enforce IMDSv2 requiring session token headers.

title: PostgreSQL Data Exfiltration Attack
description: Interception of unauthorized SQL queries attempting to dump administrative database tables and customer PII records from master database cluster.
businessImpacts: Database breach & confidential user data leakage
Compliance audit violation under HIPAA & SOC2 standards

recommendedActions.text: Apply web application firewall (WAF) SQLi rule block
Sanitize and parameterize ORM query inputs in API controller
Audit recent database query logs for suspicious UNION payloads

timeline.title: Malicious SQL payload detected
timeline.desc: UNION SELECT signature matched in request body

timeline.title: WAF eBPF filter triggered
timeline.desc: Connection dropped prior to database arrival

aiAnalysis.explanation: An attacker sent crafted HTTP requests with SQL syntax to dump administrative tables.
aiAnalysis.businessImpact: Unrestricted database access could expose sensitive user PII.
aiAnalysis.recommendedResponse: Immediately ensure all ORM queries use parameterized bindings.
futurePrevention: Run daily automated SAST/DAST vulnerability scans.
